omissions: Wave acceleration, slamming, impact, entanglement and fouling
Frame drag, array variant, cable angle/catenary and dynamic amplification
Attachment strength, seabed/farm geometry and structural stress
Real sealed displacement, flooded voids, cable buoyancy and actual mass/CG
Partial immersion, compressibility and temperature/salinity variation
Wind uplift, overturning stability and farm support loads
